what: The states method section G7.3j's plan and draw of the dates that stand out (landing 3b.6, plan P4-D369) are frozen on, each with the answer computed from the method's text: after steps 1 to 3, each listed date's run of ranks as (first rank, day, ranks) and the parts, whose ordinary ranks take the part's days, as (first day, last day, first rank, ranks); after step 4, each part's values, ascending. A case states the knots as (rank, day), the listed dates as (day, count), the holes, the weekday and day-of-month censuses as (first, last, count), the budget of new days the parts may open, the new days the count leaves the draw, and the words, one per ordinary rank.
